resources.string: Changes stay in this page until Save and refresh. Cancel leaves files unchanged.
Root versions and apply false declarations are shown separately. Edit each source explicitly; use the Kotlin card to choose shared Kotlin version declarations.
No recognized plugin declarations. Add a plugin or open the script for other expressions.
Remove this plugin declaration? Other configuration and comments remain unchanged.
Manage include and projectDir only. Module directories and source files are never created or deleted. Blank directory restores the default mapping.
Remove this include and its literal projectDir mapping? Module files will not be deleted.

Order affects resolution. Edit literal URLs only; preserve filters, credentials and unrecognized declarations. repositoriesMode stays unchanged. Creating plugin repositories retains the default Plugin Portal.
No recognized repository declarations in this block.
Maven URL (HTTPS or HTTP; no credentials)
Remove the selected repository and its scoped configuration? Comments and other declarations are preserved.
No settings.gradle or settings.gradle.kts found. Project settings are unavailable; no file will be created automatically.
No root build.gradle or build.gradle.kts found.
This declaration uses an unsupported or dynamic expression. Open the script to edit it; its original text is preserved.
Invalid input. Check the plugin ID, module path or HTTP(S) URL. Control characters are not allowed.
Multiple declarations or conflicting Android plugins prevent a safe edit. Resolve the conflict in the script first.
The selected declaration has changed or disappeared. Review plugin and feature choices before saving.
Discard unsaved plugin, Kotlin and project changes?
Project settings could not be loaded. Existing module fields remain available.
%1$s changed outside this page. Nothing will overwrite it. Reopen the page and reapply your edits.
Could not save %1$s. Earlier writes from this save were restored; drafts remain available.
Saving failed and at least one file could not be restored. Check the Gradle files before retrying.
Not explicitly declared / inherited from a plugin or platform
Gradle plugin and library versions do not switch the AIDE+ compiler. Change the compiler in toolchain management.
BOM/platform declarations can align stdlib versions. Values shown here are declarations, not the resolved dependency graph; no explicit version is added to a managed dependency.

Edit module-level compilerOptions or kotlinOptions only. All recognized declarations of the selected field are updated together; task-specific and dynamic expressions are preserved. languageVersion and apiVersion configure Gradle; this page does not change the AIDE+ compiler arguments.
AIDE+ JVM target: %1$s (Kotlin declaration, otherwise targetCompatibility or 1.8)
Declared plugin %1$s is newer than bundled compiler %2$s. AIDE+ still uses its selected toolchain; upgrading the Gradle version does not upgrade it.
Language / API version (for example 2.0; empty: remove)

Edit only the selected version literals in their source files. An ext/extra variable or catalog version may be shared with other plugins, dependencies or modules: all references to that literal will be affected. Changes remain drafts until Save and refresh.
Invalid Kotlin version. Use a version such as 2.0.21; language/API options use major.minor, or leave them empty to remove the declaration.
